intro: Drive fast, dodge traffic, and save lives in Emergency Rush!
description:
Take control of an ambulance and race through dangerous highways filled with cars, trucks, buses, and obstacles. Use nitro boosts, react quickly, and survive intense traffic as you drive across desert, forest, and snowy roads.
Every run is a test of speed, timing, and reflexes. Avoid crashes, keep moving, and reach the emergency before it is too late.

Emergency Rush is a fast, simple, and exciting ambulance driving game for players who love highway action, racing, and quick reflex challenges.
